<#if problem.examples?? && problem.examples.samples??>
<#if (problem.examples.samples?size > 0)>
\Example<#if (problem.examples.samples?size > 1)>s</#if>
\begin{StatementSamples}
<#list problem.examples.samples as sample>
<#if sample.passes?? && (sample.passes?size > 0)>
<#if sample.presentation?? && (sample.presentation = "pair")>
<#list sample.passes as pass>
<#if sample.passes?size = 1>
\StatementSampleFile{${sample.number}}{${pass.inputFile}}{${pass.outputFile}}
<#else>
\StatementSamplePassFile{${sample.number}}{${pass.number}}{${pass.inputFile}}{${pass.outputFile}}
</#if>
</#list>
<#elseif sample.presentation?? && (sample.presentation = "interaction")>
<#list sample.passes as pass>
<#if sample.passes?size = 1>
\begin{StatementSampleInteraction}{${sample.number}}
<#else>
\begin{StatementSampleInteraction}[${pass.number}]{${sample.number}}
</#if>
<#if pass.events??>
<#list pass.events as event>
\StatementSampleEventFile{${event.source}}{${event.textFile}}
</#list>
<#else>
\PackageError{olymp}{Interaction sample ${sample.number}, pass ${pass.number} has no events field}{The render-context producer must provide an events array, even when it is empty.}
</#if>
\end{StatementSampleInteraction}
</#list>
<#else>
\PackageError{olymp}{Sample ${sample.number} has an unsupported presentation}{Expected presentation to be pair or interaction.}
</#if>
<#else>
\PackageError{olymp}{Sample ${sample.number} has no passes}{Every structured sample must contain at least one complete pass.}
</#if>
</#list>
\end{StatementSamples}
</#if>
<#elseif problem.sampleTests?? && (problem.sampleTests?size > 0)>
\Example<#if (problem.sampleTests?size > 1)>s</#if>
\begin{example}
<#list problem.sampleTests as test>
\exmpfile{${test.inputFile}}{${test.outputFile}}%
</#list>
\end{example}
</#if>
